moves.why: Going for max single-play value: small puck claims a floor for 2 points. Placing large only gets 1 point and seals the bore for everyone. With 4 players racing for 6 floors, small-first is greedy-optimal.
2-point floor claim dominates a 1-point seal when the board is fresh and small pucks are abundant; build point pressure now while every bore is still open
matching the floor race that seats 0 and 1 opened, 2 points beats 1 and no one's smalls are running short yet
claiming floor on bore 3 while shelves 0-2 are still open threatens seats 0-2 with losing the floor forever if anyone else seals those shelves

Sealing bore 4 denies it to the next three players; nobody can sneak a small underneath now, and I bank 1 point before seat 1 can. Bore 5 stays open so I can still drop my second small for 2 points on the next pass.

the only open-floor bore is bore 5; taking the 2-point floor now puts me in solo lead (4 pts) and locks opponents out of a 2-point score; I'll have 3 large pucks left to seal my own bores (1 and 5) for 2 more pts on top
all remaining shelves are equivalent 1-pointers, all floors are taken so my smalls are dead, just claiming one to keep pace
bore 2 sits next to seat 2's floor at bore 1; sealing it denies seat 2 a cheap shelf while I still get a point and keep my small pucks for floors

Sealing bore 1 (which has MY floor underneath) protects my 2-point claim from anyone stealing a shelf—er, well, sealing denies ANYONE a shelf point, but more importantly the floor is already mine. Actually, sealing also makes the floor unreachable to no one (it's already taken). The value is the shelf point itself. I take it now before seat 1 (3.0+1=4) closes in.

seats 0 and 1 each hold a 2-0 advantage over me on smalls; sealing bore 3 denies seat 2 the last open-floor bore (they have 2 smalls left!) and the only 2-pt they can score elsewhere; sealing bore 5 instead leaves bore 3 wide for them. Tied for the lead, I cannot let the threat compound
last unsealed bore, I still have one large left, take the point
